agentPerformance.sampleLimit: This sample starts with the 200 most recently created agent runs across all workspaces, then includes those that ended in the selected period. It includes saved workflow runs and excludes ordinary chat turns and active runs.
agentPerformance.eventLimit: Change-request outcomes and follow-ups use retained events, up to 2,000 per run. A completed run without a recorded change request does not prove the work passed review.
